answer_text:
# 🏥 Medi-Cal — California's Medicaid Program

Here is a comprehensive overview of **Medi-Cal**, California's public health insurance program:

---

## 📌 What Is Medi-Cal?

Medi-Cal is California's Medicaid program — the state's health insurance program for Californians with low income, including three in seven children, two in nine nonelderly adults, and two in five people with disabilities.

Created in 1966 along with the federal Medicaid legislation, Medi-Cal is the largest state Medicaid program in the country and was also the first to pilot a managed care structure in the early 1970s.

The program currently serves approximately 38 million people, including seniors, children, and individuals with disabilities.

---

## ✅ What Does Medi-Cal Cover?

Full-scope Medi-Cal covers all medical, dental, mental health, vision, and other important services. It may also cover substance abuse treatment and includes transportation to medical visits.

---

## 📋 Eligibility & Key Changes

### Income Requirements
Californians still need to be aware of the income test. In order to qualify for Medi-Cal without having to contribute to a Share of Cost, residents generally need to earn no more than 138% of the Federal Poverty Level, or $14,580 per year.

### Asset Test Eliminated (2024)
On January 1, 2024, the asset test was eliminated from Medi-Cal eligibility. This means applicants will no longer be asked about what they own during the eligibility process.

### Immigration Status Expansion
Starting January 2024, all income-eligible Californians may qualify for full-scope Medi-Cal regardless of immigration status.

### Public Charge
The use of Medi-Cal and other important health, nutrition, and housing benefits does **not** count as a public charge and will not impact your immigration case.

---

## 🏦 Funding & Scale

In fiscal year 2021–22, Medi-Cal brought in more than **$85 billion** in federal funds and accounted for nearly **15% of all state general fund spending**.

People with disabilities composed 8% of Medi-Cal enrollees but accounted for 31% of spending, while children accounted for 16% of enrollees and just 6% of spending.

---

## 🔄 Managed Care

Medi-Cal has implemented new standardized contracts with its **22 managed care health plans**, which collectively cover 99% of enrollees.

The new contracts tighten enforcement of quality measures, especially for women and children, require health plans to report publicly on provider performance, and mandate that plans reveal the number of enrollees who lack access to primary care.

**CalAIM** (California Advancing and Innovating Medi-Cal) is a multiyear program intended to transform the Medi-Cal delivery system.

---

## 📞 How to Apply

You can apply for Medi-Cal through:
- **Online:** [CoveredCA.com](https://www.coveredca.com/apply/) or [BenefitsCal.com](https://www.benefitscal.com)
- **In person:** At your local county social services office
- **DHCS Website:** [dhcs.ca.gov](https://www.dhcs.ca.gov)

---
